title: Robot Decontamination Chamber Simulation
description: A robot stands inside a volumetric god-ray decontamination chamber. The user must calibrate the chamber by adjusting beam intensity, rotation speed, scan height, and pulse frequency through a control panel, then initiate a multi-phase decontamination sequence while monitoring contamination levels on the robot's body segments.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 that implements a robot decontamination chamber simulation. Load both GLB assets: 'shared_assets/godrays_demo.glb' as the decontamination chamber environment with volumetric light beams, and 'shared_assets/robot.glb' placed at the center of the chamber. Position the camera at (0, 2, 5) looking at the origin. Add ambient light (intensity 0.3) and a directional light from above (intensity 0.8). Create an HTML overlay control panel on the left side with these interactive controls: (1) a 'Beam Intensity' slider (range 0.1-1.0, default 0.5) that scales the opacity/emissive intensity of the godrays model's materials, (2) a 'Chamber Rotation' slider (0-2 RPM, default 0) that rotates the godrays model around the Y-axis encircling the robot, (3) a 'Scan Height' slider (-1.0 to 2.0 meters, default 0) that moves a visible horizontal scan plane up and down the robot, (4) a 'Pulse Frequency' dropdown (Off/Slow/Medium/Fast) that makes the godrays model pulse in brightness using sinusoidal modulation, (5) a 'Start Decontamination' button that initiates a 10-second automated sequence where the scan plane sweeps top-to-bottom while beams rotate and pulse automatically, (6) a contamination percentage display (starts at 100%) that decreases during the sequence based on the product of beam intensity and pulse frequency values. Validate all parameters before starting: beam intensity must be above 0.3, rotation must be non-zero, and pulse must not be Off — otherwise show a red warning message. During the sequence, tint robot mesh segments green progressively from top to bottom as they are 'cleaned'. Add a 'Reset Chamber' button that restores all defaults. The godrays model should visually envelope the robot. Use OrbitControls for camera interaction. Display a status bar showing current phase: IDLE, CALIBRATING, DECONTAMINATING, or COMPLETE.
